name: W&B Weave
description: Emit OpenClaw agent diagnostic events as OpenTelemetry spans to W&B Weave's Agents OTel endpoint (weave.* attributes, /agents/otel/v1/traces).

entity.description: W&B team or username slug. Optional: when omitted the plugin defaults to $USER (or $USERNAME) and logs a dev-defaults warning — set explicitly for production.

project.description: W&B project name. Optional: when omitted the plugin defaults to 'openclaw-default' and logs a dev-defaults warning — set explicitly for production.

apiKey.description: W&B API key. String literal (discouraged), { secretRef: { source, provider, id } } shape, or omit to read WANDB_API_KEY from env.

wandbBaseUrl.description: W&B install base URL — matches the Weave Python SDK's WANDB_BASE_URL env var. Default https://api.wandb.ai (cloud). For a dedicated install use your install hostname, e.g. https://acme.wandb.io. The plugin derives the trace-server URL per the Weave SDK rule (cloud -> https://trace.wandb.ai; dedicated -> <base>/traces) and appends /agents/otel/v1/traces. Falls back to WANDB_BASE_URL env var when omitted.

wfTraceServerUrl.description: Full trace-server URL override — matches the Weave Python SDK's WF_TRACE_SERVER_URL env var. Bypasses wandbBaseUrl derivation; plugin appends /agents/otel/v1/traces. Use for self-managed installs or proxy routing. Falls back to WF_TRACE_SERVER_URL env var when omitted.

agentName.description: Override for weave.agent.name. Falls back to harnessId/pluginId from events.

agentVersion.description: weave.agent.version attribute. Set 'auto' to generate <pkgVersion>+<startupTimestamp> on every gateway restart so each plugin build/restart is a distinct version row in the Agents tab. Leave unset to use the plugin package version. Set an explicit string (e.g. 'v0.1') to pin.

captureContent.description: Conversation content captured into spans. Defaults to full capture so traces are useful out of the box. Set { enabled: false } for a hard off, or flip individual sub-flags (e.g. { toolResults: false }) for granular opt-out. Sub-flags default to true; only explicit false disables a field. All captured strings pass through OpenClaw's redactSensitiveText before emission.

stripSenderWrapper.description: When true, strip OpenClaw's metadata-wrapper prefix (`Conversation info` / `Sender (untrusted metadata)` / `[timestamp]`) from user-message content before emitting weave.input.messages — applies symmetrically to historyMessages and the in-flight prompt. Default false (raw): the OTel-conforming choice. `gen_ai.input.messages` is by spec the messages used in the operation, so wrappers belong in it; Phoenix, Helicone, Langfuse, and LangSmith all do the same. Set true to opt into a cleaner Weave Agents-tab chat view (the wrapper is ~500 chars and dwarfs the user's actual question), at the cost of losing visibility into prompt-injection or wrapper-format-drift bugs.

emitGenAiAliases.description: Dual-emit OTel-canonical gen_ai.* aliases alongside every weave.* attribute that has one. Default true — improves portability to non-Weave OTel backends (Datadog, Honeycomb, LangSmith, Langfuse) that only recognize gen_ai.*. The Weave server treats both forms identically via alias resolution, so toggling does not change Weave Agents-tab data quality. Set false to halve attribute-storage cost on Weave-only deployments.

wandbBaseUrl.label: W&B Base URL
wandbBaseUrl.help: Default https://api.wandb.ai. For dedicated set to your install host, e.g. https://acme.wandb.io.

stripSenderWrapper.label: Strip Sender wrapper
stripSenderWrapper.help: Cleaner chat view at the cost of fidelity to what the LLM actually saw.

captureContent.enabled.label: Capture conversation content
captureContent.enabled.help: On by default — empty traces aren't useful. Turn off (or flip individual sub-flags) when compliance/retention policy requires it.
